reason: I pay about 1,600đ per dollar of usage through my Telegram reseller and it works fine in Cursor every day. Paying 26,000đ for the same dollar is over 15 times more; receipts and VAT invoices don't matter to a solo dev like me. I might grab the free 50,000đ and try it, but I wouldn't top up.
objection: Same models, same API, and you cost 15 times what I already pay. Invoices and model-check pages are nice, but I'm not a company that needs them.
would_change_my_mind: My reseller getting shut down or swapping in fake models so I lose work, or a client contract that requires a proper VAT invoice.
